desc:
A prototype mobile suit deployed to the mobile suit squad of the EFF's Assault Landing Ship Spartan.
Prepared by Captain Monica Humphrey for a top secret operation, it was developed through ample funding from the Moore Brotherhood.
It comes equipped with general-purpose support equipment called Sub Leg (a flight unit) for use under gravity, a stock of weapons including a railgun, and even has automatic data collection functionality during armed combat.
Rated for underwater operation, its design is intended to reduce water resistance through the use of ball joints that incorporate technology from aquatic mobile suits.

character.desc:
An EFF pilot who took part in the One Year War as a member of the Moore Brotherhood.
Toward the end of the war, he fought against the Living Dead Division in the Thunderbolt Sector aboard the Full Armor Gundam.
After being defeated by Daryl Lorenz, who was piloting the Psycho Zaku, he was made a captive of the principality. In the confusion of the Battle of A Baoa Qu, he managed to escape, eventually surviving the One Year War.
Eight months after the war, he is exceptionally chosen as the pilot of the Atlas Gundam, taking up a post on the assault landing ship Spartan.
He meets Bianca Carlyle there, with whom he shares a passion for jazz, and the two grow closer during jam sessions.
However, he cannot hide his shock upon finding Claudia Peer, who was supposed to have died in the South Seas Alliance, the destination of the operation.
He tries in vain to ask her about her motive, exasperated by the tricks that fate is playing on them.
character.name: Io Fleming

name: Atlas Gundam (EX)

series.desc:
A half-century has passed since humanity began emigrating into outer space due to overpopulation.
Hundreds of gigantic space colonies now orbit Earth, humans living along the inner walls of the colonies' main cylinders.
With almost half of humankind residing in space, these colonies have become humanity's second home where people are born, raised...and die.
It is January 1, U.C. 0079.
The furthest cluster of colonies from Earth, Side 3, has proclaimed itself the Principality of Zeon and has launched a war of independence against the Earth Federation.
In just one month of fighting, war casualties have halved their respective populations. Humanity is disgusted at the atrocities they themselves have wrought.
Eight months have passed since the rebellion began. They were at a stalemate...
series.name: Mobile Suit Gundam

series.desc:
U.C. 0079. Nearly one year has passed since the war between the Earth Federation Forces and the Principality of Zeon began.
The Side 4 space colony cluster, Moore, has been destroyed in a Zeon attack. The loss of life was enormous. The clouds of drifting debris from the colony and wrecked ships resemble forlorn spirits of the dead.
Moore has been reduced to nothing more than a perilous shoal zone. Collisions among the debris generates electricity, emitting constant arcs of lightning.
No one knows who came up with the new name for the region, but it eventually sticks. It becomes known by all as Thunderbolt Sector.
series.name: Mobile Suit Gundam Thunderbolt
